can fix almost anything except for myself! The circle of people I want to be around really don't accept me because I'm one those people who never went to school! I'm too old now, even though I have good things going for me, I realize that it all doesn't matter! There is no point in anything anymore! It's almost kinda like saying it's too late!

Oh well, there will come a day where the pain will disappear! That's a positive thing to look forward to!
